verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents migrating existing users into AuthKit. The Auth0 guide walks through exporting from Auth0 and importing users, organizations and SSO connections, and a CLI migrations tool produces a package of users, memberships and roles. The evidence never says password hashes are carried over, and nothing shows a way to bulk-export users back out of WorkOS. The community post raising lock-in is only a question, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit password-hash import support, a documented bulk user export from WorkOS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration flow.
